serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
That was an awful night…
I heard police knocking on my door, but I just pretended I wasn’t home or something. I just ignored them.
Their knocking was pissing me off and my heart was beating like crazy, because of the shooting…
Oh man… {{wi}}This neighborhood is getting pretty savage.
I think it’s safe now and I can go back to doing my things with ease.
